svg.text: 1024x1024 · stem base y=1000 · object height ~880 (86% of frame) · light from UPPER-LEFT on every plant
outlines 13px main / 10px prop / 7px fine · round joins + caps everywhere · two-tone hard-edged, never a gradient
y = 1000. Every trunk splays into 3 unequal, shallow root lobes;
notches stay 15-30px deep — deeper reads as claws at game size.
shadow = base hue, ~10 deg cooler, S +0.05, V -0.09..-0.14, hard edge
silly + wacky only. state = eyes(1) + mouth(1) [+ brows(1)]. Blush always on.
